I posted the draft as a reply in this thread. It covers the three times from #inc-vtg-hartford:

- First report: Aug 3, 10:42 AM, gate kiosks offline and both inbound lanes showing a white screen.
- Kiosk 1 back: Aug 3, 11:03 AM, trailer 8836 checked in.
- Both lanes confirmed working: Aug 3, 11:07 AM.

It also notes the open status-page access issue (INC-4821) and that kiosk 2 was left on for reconnect attempts. I didn't send anything to Mateo or procurement. This channel's members are you, Nadia and Ruth, and the draft contains only operational facts, no finance figures.
